title: Light mode, local QR bundle, hex color input, fix panel visibility
body: Four unrelated bugs: dark-mode-only styling, CDN-blocked QR library, color picker lacking hex input, and Appearance/Data cards rendering outside the edit panel toggle. ## Changes - **Light mode** — flipped CSS variables to light palette (`--bg: #f0f2f5`, `--surface: #fff`, `--text: #1a1a1a`, etc.) - **Local QR bundle** — CDN (`cdn.jsdelivr.net`) was unreachable at runtime; bundled `qrcode@1.5.3` via webpack into `qrcode.min.js` and updated the `
